name: Water Drop
description: A drop falls into the picture like into still water: round ripples spread out, bending the picture with glints, the second clip shows inside the leading ripple, and the water calms down. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: amplitude
params.description: Frequency of the ripples (higher: closer together)

params.name: speed
params.description: Speed of the ripples through the spreading rings

params.name: center
params.description: Where the drop falls (0..1, y down)

params.name: refraction
params.description: How far the ripples bend the picture, in frame heights
